content.text:
The contact form fields had lost their spacing, so the labels and inputs were crammed together. The cause was `.form-field { margin-bottom: 0; }` in `site/css/components.css`. I changed it to `margin-bottom: var(--space-4)` (16px). That is also why the page was 80px shorter than the approved screenshot: five fields at 16px each.

The visual tests for both contact screenshots (desktop and phone) now pass, as do the other visual and functional tests (28 of 28). I didn't commit anything.

STATUS: DONE
